title: The U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents: Photo Essay
summary: Portraits of U.S. citizens who were held by immigration agents over the past year, out of more than 500 cases ProPublica tracked.
summary_es: Retratos de ciudadanos estadounidenses detenidos por agentes de inmigración durante el último año, entre más de 500 casos documentados por ProPublica.

title: Photographer Carol Guzy captures how ICE's immigration arrests unfold
summary: Unposed photos from immigration courts, where ICE and federal officers waited to arrest people after their hearings.
summary_es: Fotos espontáneas en tribunales de inmigración, donde agentes de ICE y federales esperaban para arrestar a personas después de sus audiencias.

title: Disturbing Pictures of Neglect in ICE Mortality Reviews
summary: What the government's own reviews show about immigrants who died in detention in recent years.
summary_es: Lo que muestran las propias revisiones del gobierno sobre inmigrantes que murieron bajo custodia en años recientes.
